title: ZTIE PDE-handoff outcome data contract (v1)
description: The derived, bounded PDE-handoff OUTCOME produced by the Story 4.6 ACCEPT-push mechanism (RD-047), and the TENTH envelope kind on the Forensic -> Hub RD-013 gate. On a RECORDED HUMAN ACCEPT (never the advisory recommended_verdict, RD-040), the Forensic-side pusher hash-verifies the raw artifact against the Hub tracking record and pushes it ONE-DIRECTIONALLY + LEAST-PRIVILEGE to a Pipeline-Sandbox-owned landing bucket (586917955591); it then crosses THIS bounded outcome back to the Hub. It records the mechanism `outcome` (pushed / refused_not_accepted / refused_hash_mismatch — FAIL-CLOSED: a refusal means nothing left Forensic), the human decision observed on the tracking record, whether the sha256 verified, and — only when pushed — a POINTER (account / bucket / prefix / key) to where the artifact landed. The pushed artifact itself NEVER transits the Hub (RD-009/RD-013); only this pointer + bounded facts cross. It is NOT a verdict: there is NO verdict/safe/approved/forward/pass_fail/malicious/clean field anywhere; `outcome` is the MECHANISM result, the DECISION was the human accept, and the verdict is human-gated. Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (HANDOFF_CONTRACT_VERSION) + a UNIQUE 'handoff' discriminator that does not collide with any other envelope kind.

contract_version.description: PDE-handoff-outcome-contract schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the Hub validator (HANDOFF_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this envelope kind versions independently of the other nine kinds (never rides the shared CONTRACT_VERSION). The Hub rejects unknown-version envelopes fail-closed.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this handoff outcome is for. The Hub upserts the outcome onto the tracking record keyed by this.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the Hub rejects a handoff outcome whose sha256 does not match the tracked record. This is the same hash the mechanism verified before pushing (SI-7).

handed_off_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the handoff mechanism produced this outcome in Forensic (the time of the push attempt, push or refusal).

handoff.description: The bounded PDE-handoff OUTCOME: what the Story 4.6 ACCEPT-push mechanism did for this intake. It records the mechanism `outcome` (pushed / refused_not_accepted / refused_hash_mismatch), the human decision it observed on the tracking record (EVIDENCE of what gated the action), whether the sha256 verified, and — only when pushed — a POINTER to where the artifact landed in the Pipeline-Sandbox. EVIDENCE only; NO verdict anywhere. `outcome` is the mechanism result, NOT a safety judgement; the decision was the human accept.

outcome.description: What the push mechanism did. 'pushed' = a recorded human accept + a verified sha256, so the artifact was pushed and landed in the Sandbox (the ONLY outcome where bytes left Forensic). 'refused_not_accepted' / 'refused_hash_mismatch' = FAIL-CLOSED, nothing left Forensic. NEVER a safety verdict.

observed_decision.description: The human decision the mechanism read off the Hub tracking record (`human_decision`) at push time. EVIDENCE of what gated the action — the push happens ONLY on 'accepted' (RD-040/RD-047: the advisory recommended_verdict is NEVER the trigger). The decision itself is a separate, human-owned field written by the Phase-4 gate (Story 4.4), never by 4.6.

hash_verified.description: True iff the recomputed Forensic sha256 matched the Hub tracking record's sha256 (SI-7 integrity). A push happens ONLY when this is true; false records a fail-closed integrity refusal.

destination.description: Pointer to where the accepted, hash-verified artifact LANDED in the Pipeline-Sandbox account (RD-009 — the artifact is under PDE control there; only this pointer crosses to the Hub, never the payload). Present only when outcome is 'pushed'.

account_id.description: The Pipeline-Sandbox AWS account id the artifact was pushed to (the ZTIE->PDE handoff landing zone; expected 586917955591).

bucket.description: The Pipeline-Sandbox-owned S3 landing bucket the artifact was pushed to. Sandbox-owned; ZTIE holds only scoped one-prefix PutObject on it (RD-047).

prefix.description: The single least-privilege key prefix the Forensic pusher role is scoped to on the Sandbox landing bucket (the one prefix the Sandbox bucket policy grants; RD-047 least-privilege).

key.description: The full S3 key the artifact landed at in the Sandbox bucket (under the scoped prefix), e.g. accepted/<intake_id>/<filename>.

version_id.description: Optional S3 object version id returned by the cross-account PutObject (present when the landing bucket is versioned), for traceability of the exact landed object.

pushed_at.description: Optional RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the artifact was pushed to the Sandbox. Present when outcome is 'pushed'.

artifact_s3_key.description: Optional Forensic S3 key of the raw artifact that was verified + pushed (intake/<intake_id>/<filename>), for traceability. A pointer into Forensic — never the payload.

size_bytes.description: Optional size in bytes of the verified artifact that was pushed. Bounded fact, never content.

reason.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable reason for a refusal (e.g. 'no recorded human accept (human_decision=pending)' or 'sha256 mismatch: artifact does not match tracked record'). Never raw content, never a verdict.
